Product description

Take it slow with NESTLÉ TURTLES. This 600g gift box is perfect to give as a gift or share with your family and friends. Silky smooth caramel and crunchy pecans are draped in rich chocolate in this classic treat. Proudly prepared in Canada, these delicious treats are gluten-free and made with natural flavours. The NESTLÉ Cocoa Plan, in collaboration with the Rainforest Alliance, is helping cocoa farmers enhance farming practices. Closer to home, NESTLÉ Canada has supported the community by raising millions for Kids Help Phone, Canada's only 24/7 e-mental health service, available in English and French. A tradition since 1949, Canadians can't get enough of the slow pull of creamy caramel, crunchy pecans, and rich chocolate of NESTLÉ TURTLES. So, take it slow and give this beautifully striped gift box of NESTLÉ TURTLES to someone today!

Customers say

The chocolate candy receives positive feedback for its taste, with customers finding the turtles very tasty and amazing. The quality is appreciated as a nice treat and delicious chocolate gift box. Customers enjoy the texture, noting the pecans crunchiness and softness along with the creamy consistency. The size is well-received, with customers noting the nice large size and that it comes in a bigger size to share. However, some customers are disappointed with discoloration, and opinions on freshness vary among customers.

About this Item

  • Celebrate With NESTLÉ TURTLES: This large, 600g gift box of NESTLÉ TURTLES is perfect for gift-giving or sharing with family and friends
  • Classic Flavours: Silky smooth caramel and crunchy pecans draped in rich chocolate
  • Prepared In Canada: Proudly prepared in Canada
  • A Canadian Tradition Since 1949: Canadians can't get enough of the slow pull of creamy caramel, crunchy pecans, and rich chocolate of NESTLÉ TURTLES
  • Gluten-Free: NESTLÉ TURTLES are gluten-free and made with natural flavours
  • NESTLÉ Cocoa Plan: In collaboration with the Rainforest Alliance, the NESTLÉ Cocoa Plan is helping cocoa farmers enhance farming practices

Product description

Take it slow with NESTLÉ TURTLES. This 600g gift box is perfect to give as a gift or share with your family and friends. Silky smooth caramel and crunchy pecans are draped in rich chocolate in this classic treat. Proudly prepared in Canada, these delicious treats are gluten-free and made with natural flavours. The NESTLÉ Cocoa Plan, in collaboration with the Rainforest Alliance, is helping cocoa farmers enhance farming practices. Closer to home, NESTLÉ Canada has supported the community by raising millions for Kids Help Phone, Canada's only 24/7 e-mental health service, available in English and French. A tradition since 1949, Canadians can't get enough of the slow pull of creamy caramel, crunchy pecans, and rich chocolate of NESTLÉ TURTLES. So, take it slow and give this beautifully striped gift box of NESTLÉ TURTLES to someone today!

Important Information

Ingredients

Ingredients: Milk chocolate (sugar, cocoa butter‡, milk ingredients, unsweetened chocolate‡, soy lecithin, natural flavour, salt), Caramel (sugars [glucose, sugar], modified milk ingredients, modified palm oil, salt, natural flavour), Pecans. May contain: Other tree nuts, Peanuts. ‡Rainforest Alliance Certified

Directions

Serve one piece at a time. Store in a cool, dry place below 18°C.
